question: For races held at circuits in Spain between 2008 and 2012, find the average fastest lap time in seconds for drivers who achieved a rank below 15. Only consider races where the race name contains 'Grand Prix'.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(lt."XCL_048") FROM circuits AS c
INNER JOIN races AS r ON c."XCL_001" = r."XCL_068"
INNER JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON r."XCL_065" = lt."XCL_043"
WHERE c."XCL_005" = 'Spain'
  AND r."XCL_066" BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012
  AND r."XCL_069" LIKE '%Grand Prix%'
  AND lt."XCL_045" < 15

         CAST(SUBSTR(r.XCL_084, INSTR(r.XCL_084, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
JOIN circuits c ON ra.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE c.XCL_009 = 'Spain'
  AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012
  AND r.XCL_083 < 15
  AND ra.XCL_069 LIKE '%Grand Prix%'
  AND r.XCL_084 IS NOT NULL
  AND r.XCL_084 != ''
